title: Combination Sum II
prompt: Given a collection of candidate numbers (candidates) and a target number (target), find all unique combinations in candidates where the candidate numbers sum to target. Each number in candidates may only be used once in the combination. Note: The solution set must not contain duplicate combinations.
hints: Sort candidates. Same as Combination Sum but: use each candidate at most once (i+1 in recurse), and skip duplicates: if i > start and nums[i] === nums[i-1], skip.
Backtrack: for each index i from start, if duplicate (i > start && same as prev), skip. Else add, recurse with i+1, backtrack.
The skip avoids generating [1,1,6] twice when we have two 1's.
